description:
The Property
Two Double Bedrooms | Duplex Apartment | Private Balcony | Allocated Parking | 920 sq ft Approx. | Spacious Living Room | Two Bathrooms | Character Warehouse Conversion | Prime City Centre Location

An impressive two-bedroom duplex apartment forming part of the popular and characterful The Warehouse development on Plumptre Street, situated in the heart of Nottingham's vibrant city centre.

Offering approximately 920 sq ft of well-proportioned accommodation, the property provides spacious and versatile living arranged over two floors. The apartment would make an excellent home for a professional couple, first-time buyer or an attractive investment opportunity.

The apartment is entered via a welcoming hallway with stairs leading to the first floor.

The ground floor offers a generous living room, measuring approximately 5.00m x 4.20m, providing an excellent space for both relaxing and entertaining. The room benefits from large sash windows and access to the private balcony, creating a bright, spacious feel.

The separate fitted kitchen is positioned alongside the living area and offers a practical layout with ample space for cooking and storage.

To the first floor are two generously proportioned bedrooms. Bedroom one measures approximately 4.30m x 4.00m, while bedroom two is an impressive 5.10m x 3.00m, offering plenty of flexibility for a home office, dressing area or additional furniture.

The first floor is completed by an en suite and second bathroom.

Residents also benefit from a secure, allocated parking space located under the building.

The apartment combines spacious accommodation with the character and appeal associated with a converted warehouse building, making it a particularly attractive city-centre home.

LOCATION

The Warehouse is located on Plumptre Street in the heart of Nottingham, within the sought-after Lace Market area. The location is ideal for those wanting to enjoy the convenience and lifestyle that city-centre living provides.

A wide variety of restaurants, bars, cafés, shops and leisure facilities are all within easy walking distance, while the historic Lace Market and Old Market Square are close by. The area is also well served by Nottingham's excellent public transport network.

Nottingham railway station provides regular services to destinations including Leicester, Derby, Birmingham and London, while tram and bus services offer convenient connections across the city and surrounding areas.

The property is also well positioned for Nottingham's universities, making it particularly appealing to both owner-occupiers and investors. The combination of excellent amenities, transport links and city-centre convenience makes Plumptre Street a highly desirable location.

An impressive two-bedroom duplex apartment offering spacious accommodation in a superb Nottingham city-centre location. Early viewing is highly recommended.
